coefficient_count_interpretation: nominal, not effective rank or regularized degrees of freedom
metric_selection_population: 144 QR33/QR4 cells pooled, each cell equal weight; no F self-reference rows
cell_status_requirement: all 32 selected final evaluation reports COMPLETE, finite evaluation.mean_loss, positive F mean; preserve archived candidate failures

rank_correlation.population: pooled conditional-model cells; separately report same statistic by method

logistic.response: 1 iff cell loss_delta<0; zero retained as no-win 0
logistic.selection_score: in-sample integer correct predictions out of exactly 144; largest correct count wins; exact ties use c,a,b
logistic.failure: nonfinite input, one class, any ConvergenceWarning or optimizer max_iter reached blocks selection; no solver/menu retry

curve.group: equal metric values within method, preserving exact rational metric keys
curve.ordinates: equal-weight mean of cell loss_delta values, not ratio after pooling different cell raw losses
curve.point: earliest positive-to-nonpositive segment root using piecewise linear interpolation; exact zero at a right endpoint is retained
curve.multiple_crossings: retain all downward crossings and first predeclared primary; never claim all later histories win

bootstrap.resampling_unit: rep cluster; draw 32 rep indices with replacement, identical draw across every grid cell and method; F/QR pairing preserved
bootstrap.metric_selection: fixed chosen metric; not reselected in bootstrap
bootstrap.cell_recalculation: ratio of resampled mean losses, then equal-cell-mean curve
bootstrap.finite_interval: conditional finite-crossing 5%/95% order statistics; report denominator, no unconditional coverage claim
bootstrap.all_draw_envelope: for missing positive threshold draw, use 0 for lower-end completion and +infinity for upper-end completion; 5% lower/95% upper empirical inverted-CDF endpoints
bootstrap.quantile_rule: sorted sample at index ceil(q*n)-1; no interpolation with infinity
bootstrap.primary_downstream_interval: all-draw envelope; if lower=0 or upper unbounded, numerical WP3 range NOT_TESTABLE/non-discriminating; never substitute finite-only interval
bootstrap.selection_uncertainty: intervals condition on post-hoc chosen metric and fixed DGP grid; not a universal confidence guarantee

empirical_overlay.fitting_use: none; do not select metric or tune r* on real results
empirical_overlay.references: same-window frozen_F / F; never rolling_F or one_state_F
empirical_overlay.methods: original QR33/QR4 only; do not silently use QR33_plus or renamed QR4_plus as new experiments
empirical_overlay.failure: failed/unavailable input cells retained NA; no fabricated coordinate
empirical_overlay.claim: consistent/inconsistent with source post-hoc threshold only; nominal p and clocks differ
empirical_overlay.row_inclusion: Every original QR33/QR4 row in the named source tables; preserve every failed/NA cell. No empirical outcome-based subset.
empirical_overlay.pairing: Original summary: source/horizon/window/refit_step, QR versus frozen_F. QR4: source/horizon/window and original source cadence (FX24,Treasury13); origin_count must agree. Panel: series_key/horizon/window, QR33 or C2_QR4 versus frozen_F. Daily: the sealed QR33/QR4 versus F contrasts.
empirical_overlay.ambiguity: duplicate/unmatched reference or unequal issue count => report mismatch/NA and block claiming complete overlay; do not choose convenient reference

future_interfaces.rounding: retain real endpoints; no enlarging/rounding to hit learning-curve grid
future_interfaces.WP2_P3_same_r: for a/b no common discrete r support across QR33/QR4 on the requested grid: NOT_TESTABLE, no interpolation or same-W substitution; c permits matching same DGP,phi,W,H
future_interfaces.metric_c_caveat: c contains no p and cannot by itself confirm a per-parameter complexity mechanism

stop_rules: input fingerprint mismatch or incomplete selected-report pairing => BLOCKED, no rerun of old simulations
any numerical failure retained; no outcome-driven rule change
original point r* unidentified => dependent numerical predictions cannot use substitute threshold
